high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a social media post from a user named Sonanchal Gautam. The post discusses a decision made by the Indian cricket team regarding their squad composition for an upcoming match. The text reads: "So India has decided to remove Ashwin and include Thakur just to provide a balance to the side and going with 2 spinners in a pacer friendly would have not been a wise decision." The post includes a photograph of a cricketer in action, wearing a white cricket uniform with the Indian team's logo on the chest. The cricketer appears to be bowling, as indicated by the raised arm
